name: [📩] Package RNG 📦
desc:
📦 Welcome to Package RNG

📬 Pack them into boxes on a conveyor belt
🖱️ Click boxes at the end to claim your box
🌈 Get Common, Rare, Legendary, or Golden boxes

💸 Place boxes on tables to earn passive income
💰 Earn up to $1M/sec with rare boxes!

🛒 Buy more boxes in the shop with a stock system
🍀 Test your luck and build your package empire!

Inspired by Grow a Garden and Steal a Brainrot
